Tag properties give information about a tag, they can be used:
<p>
  <table border=0>
    <tr>
      <td>- as a pad tag </td>
      <td><code style="color: #000000"><b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">property</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>first</font><font color="red"></font>}</b> ... <b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">property</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>first</font><font color="red"></font>}</b></code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>- as a variable with the & prefix &nbsp; </td>
      <td><code style="color: #000000"><b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">pad</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>if </font><font color="red">&amp;first</font>}</b> ... <b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">pad</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>if</font><font color="red"></font>}</b></code></td>
    </tr>
  </table>

  <p>
    When working with properties of a tag that is deeper in the stack of tags, the name of that tag must be given.
    <p>
      <table border=0>
        <tr>
          <td>- as parameter when used as tag</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td>- as prefix, when used as &var</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td>- relative level number</td>
        </tr>
      </table>

              <td> 5   </td>
              <td> 4      </td>
              <td> 0 </td>
            </tr>
          
        
      
    
  </table><!-- END DEMO RESULT --></span></code></td></tr>

  </table>
</p>
